|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-b65c961">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/ommniboxitsworse.gif</code> as published 2 December 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b65c961784833ee85707666198a3d8bd794c032c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/ommniboxitsworse.gif holotable commit b65c961] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “USED: For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): A Good Blaster At Your Side, No Disintegrations!, Stardust, and They Will Be Lost And Confused. OR Cancel Blast The Door, Kid! or It Could Be Worse. (Immune to It's A Hit!) OR Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 26 December 2025: “USED: For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): A Good Blaster At Your Side, No Disintegrations!, Stardust, and They Will Be Lost And Confused. OR Cancel Blast The Door, Kid! or It Could Be Worse. (Immune to It's A Hit!) OR Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Ommni Box & It’s Worse”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Ommni Box & It's Worse]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
